testCase.name: [本地] S18 Dictation controls and states are announced (axe, WCAG 2 A/AA)

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A2 · P2 · 无障碍

状态和错误不播报：报错、无搜索结果、Ask AI 的回答、「Listening…」都不读出来；开关没有选中 / 按下状态

票：TFA-94745 等 · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：EFS/S22, OAT-03/S22, TC-03/S22, TC-10/S23, TC-15/S19, TC-09/S23

思路 / Approach · TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · S18 「口述控件和状态能被读屏读出来（axe，WCAG 2 A/AA）」 Dictation controls and states are announced (axe, WCAG 2 A/AA)

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U8 Dictation never leaves the physician waiting with nothing: a start or finish that fails is retried and then shown as a clear message, and the AI call time is logged separately from the total.（UAT 3.5）
  • U2 Drug names are transcribed correctly or visibly flagged when uncertain.（UAT TC-23；TFA-94423 AC 4）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual-lane fixture; Hospital pre-round editor and Nursing Home pre-round box

When Run axe with the Dictate control idle, while the session starts ('Hearing: Preparing dictation…' in the pre-round editors), 'Listening…', 'Transcribing…', and with the Recover notice shown

Then No serious or critical violations; Dictate/Stop has an accessible name and a pressed state; each state text is announced (role=status), not shown by colour alone; any future drug-name flag is perceivable without colour

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core serious/critical = 0 per state (visual-checks.ts); live-region announcement of the state change is recorded, not covered by axe. 'Wait until dictation is ready…' exists only in ListeningIndicator (Fix by voice, add-patient), not on these two surfaces, so it is not expected here

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-23.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94423 ready for qa

用读屏的医生分不清口述开没开（Dictate/Stop 按钮没有按下状态，「Listening…」也不播报），红色 Stop 按钮对比度不够。

A screen-reader user cannot tell whether dictation is on (the Dictate/Stop button exposes no pressed state and 'Listening…' is not announced), and the red Stop button is low in contrast.

依据：allure-results/c857689b…: 6 pass / 48 fail across 3 profiles. Dictate/Stop has no aria-pressed in either pre-round editor. The Preparing / Listening / Recover texts are not in live regions (recorded only). The red Stop button and the 'Hearing:' label are at 3.8:1 contrast.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: TC-23 Dictation Fidelity · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-23/S18

Dictation controls and states are announced (axe, WCAG 2 A/AA)

Tickets: TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：preround.spec.ts: cloud dictation fully scripted (prepareSession held → 'Preparing'; answered 'batch' with a synthetic oscillator microphone → 'Listening'; transcribeAudio held → 'Transcribing'; failed → Recover) in the Hospital editor and the NH box; axe per state, Dictate/Stop name + aria-pressed; live-region of each state recorded (oracle: recorded). — Announcement by a real screen reader and a real microphone are device checks; the state's live region is recorded, not judged, per the oracle.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 6 judged check(s) passed, 48 failed. All five states reached on all three profiles with cloud dictation fully scripted at the socket and a synthetic microphone: idle, 'Preparing dictation…', 'Listening…', 'Transcribing…', and the Recover notice (both contexts). State text in a live region is recorded (oracle: recorded, not judged).

产品问题：Dictate/Stop has no pressed state (aria-pressed) in either pre-round editor; its state is conveyed only by its label switching Dictate → Stop (and the editor title 'Listening…'), while the oracle asks for a name and a pressed state. The Preparing / Listening / Recover texts are not in live regions (recorded, per the oracle). The red Stop button and 'Hearing:' label fail contrast (3.8:1).

证据：附了 7 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/TC-23_S18 — 目录（63 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
